column4: 衣架、透明展柜、首饰架与红丝绒座椅，复刻奢侈品精品店熟悉的视觉符号。搭配虚构的品牌形象，这些象征元素共同营造出专属感与欲望氛围。
column5: A clothes hanger, transparent display cases, a jewellery stand and a red velvet seat recreate the familiar visual codes of a luxury boutique. Together with an invented brand identity, these symbolic elements construct an atmosphere of exclusivity and desire.

column4: 与精品店形成对照，这一场景指向奢侈品背后的生产空间。 反复修改的草图铺满留有痕迹的面料背景。传送带上，由拉链、纽扣与其他服装部件缝制而成的物件， 象征着在一轮轮组装工序中流转的商品。
column5: In contrast to the boutique, this scene evokes the production space behind luxury goods. Reworked sketches cover a marked fabric backdrop. On the conveyor belt, objects sewn from zips, buttons and other garment components stand in for products moving through repeated cycles of assembly

column4: 黑色板面印有虚构品牌名，以及我设计的、带有奢华气质的标识。一旁布满反复标记与修改痕迹的板面，如同工厂或制版工作室的工作稿。二者并置，将精致的品牌包装与生产过程的杂乱，收纳在同一视野之中。
column5: The black surface carries a fictional brand name and a logo I designed to evoke luxury. Beside it, a repeatedly marked and revised surface resembles a working sheet from a factory or pattern-making studio. Their contrast brings polished branding and the disorder of making into the same frame.
